I think they're in this bag.''"<br />"''You're not going to have any chance to read until after takeoff anyway.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and Jaina Solo|<ref name="Ambush at Corellia">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>}}
A '''book chip''', or '''bookchip''', was a device used to read. In [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]] and [[Anakin Solo|Anakin]] [[Solo family/Legends|Solo]] brought book chips on their trip to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] with their family.
